appalling service – avoid Limelight Health at all costs.
I was booked a follow-up telephone consultation three weeks in advance. I stayed in all day from 7am, phone in hand, waiting for the call. Nothing. No call, no missed-call notification, no voicemail.
When I rang the surgery, I was told the doctor apparently “called twice and I didn’t answer” – completely untrue. The receptionist refused to investigate, offered no apology, and just said “nothing can be done” and “we’ll just go round in circles”. I now have to start the entire process again and wait weeks more for the appointment I should have had.
No accountability, no empathy, and what appears to be a falsified clinical record stating calls were made when they weren’t. Patients are being blamed for the surgery’s failures. Reception staff clearly need urgent training and better systems are needed to stop this kind of thing happening.
Deeply unhappy and still without the medical follow-up I need.
